evidence.claim: Create Nivo agentos-module-studio for an authenticated owner of one exact ready AgentOS workspace: create and manage workspace-owned custom module drafts; collect requirements through a backend-owned adaptive follow-up interview that persists answers, computes missing fields and exposes progress; accept image and document attachments through quarantined scanned uploads with retry and removal; store named integration keys as write-only encrypted server-side secrets and return only masked configuration status; generate a reviewable module specification only when complete; require an explicit publish/install action; preserve existing catalogue installation and installation-detail flows; use the TEDO page only as interaction-shape evidence and import none of its product facts.
The current frontend mounts one exact owner-scoped module installation detail under workspaceId and installationId.
The current connected module center owns the immutable catalogue and exact-workspace installation list reads.
The current frontend installs a catalogue key idempotently and links installed rows to the existing exact-workspace installation-detail route.
The current frontend contract defines two immutable catalogue keys, installation summaries and an install input with workspace, catalogue key and idempotency identity.
The current frontend operations read the catalogue, exact-workspace installations and one installation detail and submit the existing install mutation.
The current backend install input accepts one exact workspace, one of two fixed catalogue keys and an idempotency identity.
The current backend installation is an immutable package lifecycle row owned by an exact workspace and unique by workspace plus module key.
The current solution-module manifest is an immutable Nivo-owned package contract with fixed keys, versions, agent templates, channel roles, tool bindings and knowledge locator.
The current backend installation collection is read through exact user and workspace ownership.

Every Nivo AgentOS workspace can own many modules; every module has exactly one kind, every kind uses the shared persistent collaborative chat and resolves one adaptive workbench, typed trusted widgets may render inside chat, module settings stay module-scoped, and technical package evidence moves to progressive diagnostics.
Workbench examples include chatbot inbox, document surface, accounting spreadsheet and scheduling calendar; they illustrate extensibility and do not form a closed enum.
The shared chat may render interactive HTML-like widgets only through a typed trusted widget contract rather than arbitrary page markup.

Authenticated staging observation showed AgentOS dashboard, order flow, workspace control center, solution catalogue, installed module list, workspace AI readiness and package-oriented module detail; the module detail had no shared chat or kind workbench and its AI & Knowledge action routed to the workspace-level area.

Every module has many chat sessions: exactly one private resumable setup chat session teaches and revises versioned business context, while zero-to-many independent collaborative execute chat sessions perform operational work. Opening Setup resumes the same session; New chat creates only an execute session; applied context changes never rewrite prior execute history.

Keep custom module capability for later while shipping Support Desk/customer-support, Finance Copilot/accounting, Scheduling AI/calendar-assistant and Knowledge Hub/document-research first. Seed one proof workspace from public-safe versioned .gitmounts/data packages with two installations per kind and one Setup chat per installation, exactly eight initial-kind installations total. Nivo may generate the simple bootstrap knowledge. Kind-declared credentials are entered in module Settings, stored write-only and encrypted, and never written to the operational-data mount.
